# Decision: RAG v2

Implement B+C+G1+G4: an additive chunked pgvector v2 store, durable batched embedding refresh, deterministic hybrid FTS/vector retrieval, a bounded per-process query-vector cache, and one immutable authorized context snapshot per AI job. Keep v1 live through dual write/shadow read. Defer external vector DB, PostgreSQL shared query cache/result cache, and same-LLM reranking; reject in-place v1 alteration and separate reranker.

## Schema and compatibility

Add idempotent `_ensure_ticket_search_chunks_v2` in `app/backend/database.py`, behind `TICKET_RAG_V2_*` flags. `ticket_search_chunks_v2`: `chunk_id uuid PK, tenant_id, source_type, source_id, parent_ticket_id, chunk_index, section_path, content, content_hash, parent_hash, source_revision, authority_json, embedding vector(D), embedding_identity, embedded_at, created_at, updated_at`, unique `(tenant_id,source_type,source_id,parent_hash,chunk_index)`. Add HNSW cosine, GIN `to_tsvector('simple', section_path||content)`, and btree tenant/source, parent ticket, tenant/identity indexes. `rag_v2_schema_meta` persists `embedding_dimensions`; startup validates configured D=1..4096 and exact match before v2 reads/writes (identity/dimension changes need a new disabled version, never ALTER). Add `ticket_embedding_refresh_v2(refresh_key PK, tenant/source IDs, desired_hash/revision/identity, state, lease_owner/expires, attempts,next_attempt,last_error,updated_at)` and `ai_retrieval_context_snapshots(snapshot_id PK, ai_job_id unique nullable, tenant_id, auth_fingerprint, corpus_generation, embedding_identity, query_hash, chunk_refs, snapshot_digest, expires_at)`. V1 stays serving fallback; no destructive rollback. Later retirement only after a separate approved retention/reconciliation window.

## Chunks and refresh

Canonicalize only currently eligible evidence, retaining existing redaction/policy. Split headings, then paragraphs, then sentences: target 450 tokens (bootstrap), max 600, adjacent overlap <=50; short ticket descriptions/comments remain one parent chunk. `chunk_id=UUIDv5(tenant|type|source|parent_hash|index|chunker_identity)`; hashes are SHA-256 canonical text. A short transaction, after live eligibility/hash/revision/identity check, deletes obsolete parent chunks and upserts the exact set. Archive/delete/unpublish/portal/private-policy failure removes all parent chunks. Citations use chunk ID/section/excerpt but resolve live parent authority; model citations must be snapshot allowlist and actions remain approved-KB-only.

Use narrow durable refresh leases, not generic `ai_jobs`: idempotent enqueue plus periodic stale scan avoids missed wakeups; workers claim with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, expiring leases recover worker death. New `_embed_texts` in `ticket_vectors.py` batches up to 32 contract/budget-bounded inputs, retaining current endpoint/redaction/concurrency/RPM/TPM/daily/timeout controls and never holding DB sessions across provider calls. Require exactly indexed finite D-dimensional vectors. At most two attempts/item with bounded jitter; split retryable partial/toxic batches until a singleton is quarantined. Before conditional commit re-read source and require desired eligibility/hash/revision/identity: late results are discarded/requeued, never resurrected.

## Retrieval and agents

Compute current `auth_fingerprint` from tenant, actor/role, assignment, portal/private/KB policy. Start FTS on one short-lived SQLAlchemy session while obtaining query embedding from bounded local LRU (2,000, 45-minute bootstrap) or provider; vector search then uses a separate session. Key is SHA-256 of tenant, auth fingerprint, normalized-query hash, identity, dimensions; cache stores no raw query and is memory-only. Each lexical/vector SQL applies every existing authoritative predicate before each family LIMIT; cache/snapshot hits revalidate live source and authorization. Non-KB uses 40+40 candidates; KB 16+16 (bootstrap). Per chunk `score=sum_L 1/(60+rank_L)`, rank 1-based; never mix raw FTS/cosine values. Ties: authority, eligible KB, best rank, KB/ticket/comment, parent/source/index. Reserve two eligible KB passages, select 6–10 within existing token cap, <=2 chunks per parent and ticket. Vector failure uses authorized lexical only; family failure is fail-closed/degraded.

Persist a snapshot containing encrypted-at-rest source IDs/chunk hashes/citation metadata (not raw query/prompt), digest, auth fingerprint, corpus generation and identity; expiry=min(job retention,24h bootstrap). Triage binds `snapshot_id/digest/allowlist`; conditional same-model reviewer receives exactly it. Re-retrieve only when live auth, corpus/source generation, or embedding identity differs; otherwise reuse. Generated output is never indexed.

## Files/phases

P0: `ticket_vectors.py` metrics and labelled fixtures, `docs/rag-v2.md` baseline. P1: `settings.py` validated flags/limits, `database.py` v2 DDL, `ticket_vectors.py` chunker/batch/lease/cache/writer, migration/settings tests. P2: v2 FTS/vector/RRF/diversity/snapshot in `ticket_vectors.py`; bind snapshot in existing API/job integration (`main.py`/AI contract module); shadow-read tests. P3: Helm values/templates, docs and bounded tenant canary/backfill; then v2 reads. P4: reconciler/index ANALYZE maintenance and later separately approved v1 retirement.

## Verification/operations

Labelled set covers identifiers, paraphrases, long KB, competing comments, scope poison, stale, duplicates, no-answer. Gate: relevance not below v1; warm p95<250ms, cached<400ms, cold<2s, freshness p95<60s; zero stale/unauthorized evidence and no ticket API regression at observed corpus+100k chunks; stress 1M safe synthetic chunks before E. Measure Recall@5/10, MRR/NDCG@10, KB presence, duplicate/citation/action/no-answer quality; p50/95/99, cache age/hit, batches/provider, lag/retry/stale, divergence, rows/query, DB CPU/IO/locks/index, tokens, and LLM latency separately. Inject timeout/partial/malformed/wrong-D/toxic batch, delayed edit/delete/unpublish, worker death/missed wakeup/DB restart, stale cache/snapshot, policy poison and chunk flooding.

Flags default off: write, shadow-read, read, cache, tenant allowlist. Stop promotion/revert reads to v1 and pause backfill on any unauthorized/stale/citation bypass, unexplained reconciliation loss, dimension mismatch, provider budget exhaustion, DB/API headroom regression, or gate miss. Periodic reconciler compares every eligible parent hash/revision/identity and expected chunk IDs, requeues divergence, and validates snapshots live. Expire snapshots/lease history under approved retention; purge chunks with ineligible source policy. Unknowns retained: actual corpus/QPS/repetition/length/provider contract/latency/DB headroom/relevance baseline and whether shared encrypted cache is justified.
